summaries.zh: Model-driven context management (Active Context Pruning / ACP) for the DeepSeek Harness — the model decides when and what to compress. Ported from billion-context-pi (ranxianglei); acp-kernel reused verbatim. CompactionEngine backend with compress/decompress/search_context/acp_status tools.
